description: List ScrapeUnblocker's ready-made site plugins: scrapers for specific sites that return clean structured JSON (Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, Zillow, Redfin, Booking.com, Airbnb, Indeed, Glassdoor, Google Trends / Shopping / Maps, YouTube, Spotify, App Store, Google Play, Trustpilot, Yelp, Ahrefs, Semrush and 100+ more). Check here before scraping a known site with fetch_html - a plugin returns the data already parsed. Without arguments it lists every plugin with its parameters (* = required); `category` or `search` narrow the list; `name` returns one plugin's full parameter docs. Free - it calls nothing.

name.description: A plugin name, for its full parameter docs.

search.description: Only plugins whose name or description mentions this, e.g. 'zillow' or 'reviews'.
